title: The Importance of the Sun
text:
The sun is the main source of energy for Earth.
Plants use sunlight to make their own food.
Animals depend on plants for energy.
Without sunlight, plants would not grow.
This would affect all living things.

questions.question_text: What is the sun for Earth?
questions.hint: Read the first sentence of the text.
questions.feedback: The sun is an energy source for Earth. The first sentence says it is the main source of energy.

questions.question_text: What do plants do with sunlight?
questions.hint: Read the second sentence of the text.
questions.feedback: Plants use sunlight to make food. The second sentence says this directly.

questions.hint: Read the third sentence of the text.
questions.feedback: Animals are affected because they depend on plants for energy.

questions.hint: Read the fourth sentence of the text.
questions.feedback: Without sunlight, plants would not grow. The text says this directly.

questions.hint: Think about what the whole text explains.
questions.feedback: The main idea is the importance of the sun. The text explains how the sun supports plants, animals, and all living things.

title: Saving Water
text:
Water is important, but it is not unlimited.
People use water for drinking, cleaning, and farming.
Sometimes, people waste water without noticing.
Turning off taps and fixing leaks can save water.
Saving water helps people and the environment.

questions.hint: Read the second sentence of the text.
questions.feedback: Water is important for daily needs like drinking, cleaning, and farming.

questions.hint: Read the third sentence of the text.
questions.feedback: The problem is that water is wasted. The text says people sometimes waste water without noticing.

questions.hint: Read the fourth sentence of the text.
questions.feedback: We can save water by turning off taps and fixing leaks.

questions.hint: Read the last sentence of the text.
questions.feedback: Both people and the environment benefit from saving water.

questions.hint: Think about what the text teaches about water.
questions.feedback: The main idea is saving water. The text explains why water matters and how people can avoid wasting it.

title: Why Birds Fly South
text:

Flying south helps them survive.
When the weather becomes warm again, they return.
This movement is part of their life cycle.

questions.hint: Read the second sentence of the text.

questions.hint: Read the third sentence of the text.
questions.feedback: Flying south helps birds survive.

questions.feedback: Birds return when the weather becomes warm again.

questions.hint: Think about the whole movement of birds going and returning.
questions.feedback: The main idea is bird migration. The text explains why birds move to warmer places and return later.
